title: Binghatti Dusk
about:
Dusk by Binghatti is a mixed-use project by Binghatti, featuring a modern building designed with the latest architectural trends. The building features four floors and two basement levels. It offers studio and 1-bedroom apartments with stunning views of the Jumeirah Village Circle district. 

There are also two retail units available for sale in Binghatti Dusk Project by Binghatti Developers. Residents can enjoy amenities such as a swimming pool, gym, and more. The convenient location provides easy access to educational and medical facilities, stores, cafes, and restaurants.

characteristics_module.title: Spacious Apartments Offer a Bright and Spacious Ambience.
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• With 105 residential units, including 52 studio apartments and 53 1-bedroom apartments, Binghatti Dusk in
  • Jumeirah Village Circle offers a variety of living spaces.
  • Residents of Binghatti Dusk at JVC enjoy breathtaking views of the JVC community.
  • The building has an exquisite sun lounge and swimming pool, along with a wellness center that ensures the holistic well-being of the residents.
  • There are also two basement levels dedicated to parking.
  • Circle Mall is just 5 minutes away from the apartments.

location_tile.title: A Serene Community With a Rapidly Growing Property Market
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
The strategic location of JVC provides easy access to major highways, connecting residents to the rest of Dubai. Key destinations such as Dubai Marina, Mall of the Emirates, and Palm Jumeirah are just a short drive away, making it a convenient place for those who enjoy both tranquility and accessibility. 
The community is also home to a range of dining and entertainment options, enhancing the overall lifestyle experience. With its blend of modern amenities and peaceful surroundings, JVC is an ideal choice for families, professionals, and investors looking for quality living in Dubai.

5 Minutes to Circle Mall
7 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
12 Minutes to Downtown Dubai

seo.metaTitle: Binghatti Dusk Project by Binghatti Developers
seo.metaDescription: Enjoy a comfortable lifestyle in Binghatti Dusk at JVC. The low-rise building features studio and 1-bedroom apartments.

more_info.answer: Dusk by Binghatti features a selection of elegant living spaces, including cozy 1-bedroom apartments and stylish studio apartments.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available at Dusk by Binghatti?

more_info.answer: Residents of Dusk by Binghatti have access to a range of premium amenities, such as a swimming pool, a modern gym, a luxurious lobby, and retail outlets on the first floor. The wellness center offers refined, personalized experiences in an exceptionally elegant setting.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents enjoy at Dusk by Binghatti?

more_info.answer: Dusk by Binghatti is situated in the Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC) district of Dubai. Its prime location offers easy access to major highways, enabling residents to quickly reach key destinations like Circle Mall, Mall of the Emirates, Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Business Bay, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Mall.
more_info.question: Where is Dusk by Binghatti located, and what are the nearby attractions?

more_info.answer: JVC boasts a wide array of amenities, including schools, healthcare facilities, retail outlets, parks, and recreational areas. Residents also have access to numerous dining and entertainment options within the community.
more_info.question: What amenities are available in Jumeirah Village Circle?

more_info.answer: Yes, JVC is known for its family-friendly environment. The community features ample green spaces, parks, and recreational facilities, providing a safe and enjoyable atmosphere for families with children.
more_info.question: Is Jumeirah Village Circle a family-friendly community?
